location_description:
Zillah is a city in Yakima County, Washington, United States, with a population of 3,179 as of the 2020 census.


== History ==
Zillah was founded in 1891 following the completion of the Sunnyside Canal project, an irrigation scheme delivering water from the Yakima River to the arid lower Yakima Valley. Walter Granger, superintendent of the canal company, chose the town site in 1892.
